jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again
 

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What you'll do :
 
 

• Understand clients' business needs and translate them into clear, feasible end-to-end AI solutions 

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout the project, from scoping to delivery 

• Run discovery sessions and technical workshops with business and technical stakeholders 

• Design and build AI solutions combining LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers and user interfaces 

• Develop agents and RAG pipelines connecting client data to LLMs for grounded, reliable answers 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality and reduce hallucinations 

• Build, train and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering) when they are the best fit for the problem 

• Handle the data side: gathering, cleaning, validating data quality and feature engineering 

• Evaluate solutions rigorously, using ML metrics, generative AI metrics and production monitoring (quality, drift, costs) 

• Deploy solutions to the cloud with attention to security, reliability and cost efficiency, including versioning and reproducibility of models and data 

• Present and explain AI concepts, trade-offs and results to non-technical audiences 

• Support sales in qualifying opportunities, estimating effort and writing proposals 

• Contribute to demos, proofs of concept and internal knowledge sharing 

Who we're looking for :
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field 

• You have 2 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You're proficient in Python and software development best practices 

• You have strong machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model validation and the statistics behind them 

• You have hands-on experience with the Python data and ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, generation parameters, RAG and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as the OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, FastAPI and Docker 

• You're comfortable working with data in SQL databases 

• You're a natural consultant: you listen, ask the right questions and see the business behind the technical problem 

• You're comfortable presenting to clients and explaining complex topics simply 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in English and French or Dutch

jobs.occupation: Communications and Media Relations Manager M/W/X
jobs.description:
About the position 
The Communications and Media Relations Manager leads ECF's communications and visibility, while also supporting EuroVelo and Velo-city brands, towards EU institutions, the media, project partners and international stakeholders.  

You will report to the CEO, manage the Communications team, and work closely with the other teams across ECF to ensure that our messages are clear and that the voice of cyclists is heard and acted upon by policy- and decision-makers in Brussels, across Europe and beyond. 

• Strategy & Planning 
• Develop, implement and evaluate the annual communications and media relations plan, aligning activities with ECF's organisational priorities and strategic objectives 
• Ensure consistency of messaging across all channels and audiences 
• Manage and allocate team resources according to priorities (currently 2.5 FTE) 
• Coordinate ECF's visibility at key conferences and events, monitor speaking engagements and booth preparations where applicable 
• Lead on the drafting, design and publication of the ECF Annual Report.  
      2. Content Creation & Editorial Management 

• Oversee the creation of high-quality content (news, articles, speeches, newsletters, reports) based on ECF advocacy priorities and knowledge products 
• Develop core messaging and campaigns to support our advocacy and fundraising efforts 
• Plan and create content (written and visual) for ECF's audiences, including the website, newsletters, social media, and press 
• Oversee communications for EU-funded projects and contribute to relevant deliverables and reporting 
       3. Media Relations 

• Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, media outlets, and opinion leaders 
• Draft and distribute press releases, media pitches, and statements 
• Coordinate media interviews, briefings, and press events 
• Monitor media coverage and manage reputational issues and crisis communications when needed 
       4. Digital & Internal Communications 

• Manage ECF's website, mailing system and digital communication channels (CMS, CRM, Brevo, newsletters, press releases, LinkedIn, Instagram, Bluesky)  
• Develop a digital communications strategy to ensure high engagement and grow ECF's audience 
• Support all ECF teams with key messages, talking points, and presentations 
 
 Who are we looking for? 
Background: 

• A degree in a relevant field and/or relevant professional qualifications in communications or journalism  
• At least 5 years' experience in a communications role, e.g. in advocacy, public administration, PR consultancy or similar, with a proven track record 
• Experience in advocacy, campaigning and media relations  
• Experience managing a team 
• 
Experience working in an international and/or membership-based organisation is a plus. 

 

Competencies, skills and attributes: 

• Highly motivated, open-minded, proactive and results-oriented  
• A team player who works well in diverse teams, and is an effective networker 
• Ability to plan and structure communications activities to maximise their impact  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (near-native proficiency) 
• Design and social media skills and ability to explore different formats for different audiences and objectives (visuals, videos and graphics) 
Must have at recruitment 

• Proven experience in communications and media relations 
• Experience in advocacy communications and/or campaigning 
• Excellent writing and editing skills 
• Strong command of English.  What we offer 
ECF offers an employment package in line with similar non-governmental organizations based in Brussels, including a gross monthly salary of €4,200- €4,800, depending on relevant experience. Benefits include flexible working hours, up to 20 legal and 10 extra-legal vacation days (pro rata), public transport and cycling allowances, a work-from-home allowance, lunch vouchers, eco-cheques and an extra-legal pension scheme.

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset
